facts.fact: 醉酒的 Beppe 披着毯子扮“山妖之王 Orko-Borko”撞进大车，Hostian 被吵醒、Rufis 翻身骂他
facts.anchor: The door of the wagon banged open

facts.fact: Beppe 哭着指控全团把他落在酒馆，实际是他自己钻到桌子底下抱着酒壶，没人看见
十岁的 Daley 是团里最小的，也是 Beppe 清醒时唯一敢欺负的对象，他选择不掺和
facts.anchor: Daley knew better than to involve himself

facts.fact: 剧团靠赶集日演出收二十三十个铜板维生，市集稀少，春末回首都 Hernysadharc 待夏
facts.anchor: Passing the hat around after a successful show

facts.fact: 母亲 Ardis 在楼上与班主 Yuval 对质，说出他在 Nabban 另有妻子
facts.anchor: Hostian told me! He told me about your wife back in Nabban.

facts.fact: 母亲喊出这句后，阳台栏杆断裂（原文未写是否被推），她坠落院中石板地
facts.anchor: Take your hands off me! I won’t be silenced!

facts.fact: Daley 从屋顶探头，看见母亲四肢不正常摊开的尸体，随即爬下屋顶
Daley 拿火把烧了两辆大车，把 Rufis 与 Hostian 赶下车
facts.anchor: Daley leaned in just long enough to set flame

facts.fact: 被忘在车里的 Beppe 在火中惨叫，Daley 折返把他拖出来，然后逃进 Salt Hill 区
facts.anchor: the drunken dwarf had awakened to find himself surrounded by leaping flames
